title: Knowledge Memory Claim
description: One immutable, identified assertion distilled from a conversation or record: subject, property, value, valid time, speaker/source and epistemic posture as typed fields. `posture` is how the speaker asserted it (stated / proposed / hypothetical / retracted); it is not the claim's review state, which is derived from its routing decision and any Survey review (see memory-routing-decision.schema.json). `id` is the sha256 digest of the claim's content (case-folded subject, property, value and speaker; valid time; posture; supersedes; audience; source.ref), recomputed on read. The evidence fields (source.locator, excerpt, observedAt, role, extractor) are not part of identity, so two extraction passes that find the same fact find the same claim. A revision is a new claim with a new id. Field names follow the Surface knowledge-accumulation decision (subject type/id, property slot, half-open valid time, supersedes edges). Those edge and interval shapes are proposed there pending Hachure; this schema carries them as caller-owned fields and is not a Hachure bundle.

value.description: Any JSON value. Equality is structural JSON equality.

validTime.description: Half-open interval [from, until) of when the assertion says the value held in the world. Absent bounds are unbounded; an absent validTime asserts no bound.

speaker.description: Who asserted it, as named in the source.

ref.description: Stable source identity, for example a sitting id.

excerpt.description: Verbatim quote the extractor grounded the claim in.

role.description: Role of the turn the claim was grounded in.

audience.description: Principals allowed to see the claim. Absent means it inherits its source's audience; omission never widens.
